name.value: UNO: My Hero Academia (McDonald's Happy Meal Edition)

item.description:
This is a travel-sized promotional card game released globally as part of the 2026 McDonald's "UNO x Anime" Happy Meal crossover campaign. Packaged in a bright green box featuring Izuku Midoriya (Deku) ready for action, this officially licensed mini-deck shrinks the traditional Mattel game formula into a streamlined 43-card format designed for 2 to 4 players.
The deck is divided into four vibrant colored suits adorned with dynamic character illustrations of U.A. High School's Class 1-A heroes, including Deku, Bakugo, Todoroki, and Ochaco, alongside the legendary All Might. Players attempt to empty their hands by matching colors or numbers, while strategic action variants like Skip, Reverse, and Draw 1 keep the flow unpredictable.
This promotional set includes a franchise-exclusive holographic foil "One For All: Full Cowling" Wild Card. When played, the active player names the next color to continue play and channels Deku's power to force the next player in turn order to choose between drawing 3 cards immediately or passing their entire upcoming turn completely.

This UNO special edition features the characters from the Studio Ghibli film "My Neighbor Totoro"! Cards feature pictures of Mei, Satsuki and Totoro along with other characters from the movie.
The game contains 112 cards. 25 each of four colour sets (red, green, yellow, blue - 1 x 0 card, 2 x number cards 2 to 9, 2 x Reverse, 2 x Skip, 2 x Draw 2) plus 4 of three wild card types (Wild, Wild Draw 4, Sanbo Wild)
The game plays like a standard game of UNO with only one exception. The Sanbo Wild, or "Walk" card, is exclusive to this version of UNO - when played each player must give their hand to the next clockwise player. The person who played the card then chooses the colour. If drawn as the first card it should be returned to the deck and a new card drawn.

name.value: UNO: National Football League NFL Editions
UNO: National Football League AFC Edition
UNO: National Football League NFC Edition

item.description:
The usual Uno rules - Players race to empty their hands and catch opposing players with cards left in theirs, which score points. In turns, players attempt to play a card by matching its color or number to the topmost card on the discard pile. If unable to play, players draw cards from the draw pile until they are able to place a card. Wild and special cards spice things up a bit. Additionally, when playing their penultimate card from their hand, players must shout 'UNO' or face a forfeit of drawing two further cards.
These two football themed editions of UNO feature pictures of AFC and NFC stars on the cards.
WHAT MAKES THIS DIFFERENT FROM TRADITIONAL UNO: 'Champs Card' - When this card is played, the player who plays it selects another player to draw cards. That player must draw until he has drawn a number 4 card or seven cards total. The player playing the 'Champs Card' also selects the new color of play.
